name: How long does it take to install decorative wall molding in a typical room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install decorative wall molding in a typical room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for installing decorative wall molding depends on several factors, including the room size, the type and intricacy of the molding, and any necessary wall preparation. A single room with straightforward crown molding might take one to two days, while a multi-room project with various molding types and detailed corners could extend to several days or even a week. Ensuring walls are clean and ready for installation can help expedite the process. Our team plans projects efficiently to minimize disruption, especially for homes in Boise Heights and similar areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by room size, molding type, and complexity, from a few days for a single room to over a week for larger projects.
